prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-02 for page 34-X-12-auth-verify-email, state default. Reference state: verification email has been sent and the user may need to resend or choose another account path. Make this concept action-sequence oriented.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS frame, device frame, or watermark. Auth-only screen. Center a 480px card. Top: mail status icon and title. Section 1: sent-message confirmation and target email input. Section 2: resend verification email CTA and cooldown note. Section 3: not received help with spam/wait guidance and other-email signup. Section 4: login/password reset actions, home link.
Style/medium: polished Ant Design-compatible auth flow, compact, neutral, sequential dividers, no decorative illustration.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian primary resend button only; secondary buttons neutral; muted helper text.
Typography: Cosmica-like sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, clear section titles.
Must preserve state signals: verification email sent, email input, resend verification email, cooldown/frequency note, not-received guidance, other email signup, login/password reset/home actions.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, gradients, colorful CTA, decorative mailbox art, large shadow, huge rounded corners.
